scientific_intent.scientific_task: Select quantization scale and integer zero point from min/max bounds.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: Extend range to contain zero, optionally symmetrize crossing-zero bounds, choose scale and rounded clamped zero point.
scientific_intent.discretization_or_topology: 262144 independent pairs of Float32 bounds; qrange[-127,127],preserve_sparsity=true.
invariants: Scale nonzero fallback0.1 for zero/reciprocal-infinite scale.
Zero point clamped to quantized integer interval.
accuracy_requirements: All262144 scales and262144 zero points exported asFloat64, absolute1e-3 dual/CPU check.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Symmetric-bound division is Float32 in native but Float64 in inherited Julia; tie/rounding boundaries may differ outside fixture.
scientific_intent.input_size_regimes: Named synthetic bound pairs only; preserve_sparsity=false and other qranges unmeasured.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Quantized tensor parameter calibration primitive; no particular model or calibration dataset established.
scientific_intent.uncertainty: Produces parameters rather than quantizing tensor values; tolerance does not establish all rounding-boundary cases.
